title: 第22章 禁煞第23章 东南
content_zh:
天鼎峰苍穹御府内，九十九盏青铜古灯摇曳的火光将殿内照得如同白昼。
神鹰族族长鹰无涯端坐宗主玉座之上，玄色袍服上以金线绣就的展翅雄鹰在灯火映照下泛着冷冽寒光。
这位涤妄境九层的大修士右手食指有节奏地轻叩扶手，玄冰铁制成的扶手发出清脆的声，在寂静的大殿中格外刺耳。
今日议的是灵台明镜膏一事。
鹰无涯的声音如同金铁交鸣，带着不容置疑的威严，墨雪峰主，既然你执意要议此事，便先说说吧。
墨雪峰主江雪寒向前三步，腰间佩剑的一声自动出鞘三寸，剑身震颤发出龙吟般的清响。
他须发皆张，怒声道：宗主以灵台明镜膏称呼外宗毒物，恕老夫万难苟同！
袖袍无风自动，显是怒极，隐雾宗等外道邪修，将此等恶毒冠以灵台明镜之名，分明是要诱使我宗修士凡人趋之若鹜，好从中牟取暴利！
他猛地一挥手，殿中凭空浮现两团光影。
左侧显现出凡人吸食后形销骨立的惨状，右侧则是修士经脉中灵力阻滞的影像。
此毒分作两类：其一名为逍遥散，专害凡人。
吸食者初时飘飘欲仙，日久则形神俱损，终成行尸走肉；其二唤作蚀心毒煞，专毁修士道基。
江雪寒剑指右侧光影，声音愈发凌厉，邪修谎称此毒可助顿悟天道，实则不过是炼制的幻毒，使人堕入伪境！
更歹毒的是——他剑锋一转，光影中显现出缠绕在经脉上的黑色丝线，此毒含有经特殊手法炼制的黑魂草，一经沾染，如附骨之疽，终生难除！
殿中古灯的火光突然齐齐一暗，仿佛也被这番话语中的怒意所慑。
江雪寒袍袖一振，一面澄澈水镜自袖中飞出，悬于大殿中央。
镜面泛起涟漪，逐渐显现出一幅令人心惊的画面——
诸位且看这三年来我宗灵石流向。
镜中景象化作一条奔腾的灵石长河，璀璨的灵光中，竟有近四成流向隐雾宗所在的西北方向。
仅去年一年，因购买此毒外流的灵石就达七百八十万枚！

江雪寒剑指镜面，一道银光划过，将流向隐雾宗的灵石单独标记出来。
那些灵石堆积成山，在镜中投下巨大的阴影。
天璇峰主霍然起身，玉冠上的明珠剧烈晃动：这相当于我宗三座中型灵矿的年产量！
祸患远不止于此。
江雪寒剑锋一转，水镜画面流转，显现出东南三十城的景象。
只见数名身着太始道宗服饰的修士，正在府邸中收受隐雾宗使者递来的黑色玉匣。
那使者袖口绣着的石碑标记，在镜中清晰可见。
更可怕的是腐蚀之害。
江雪寒声音沉痛，已有二百三十七名驻守修士因受贿被查。
镜中画面再变，显示出这些修士克扣月俸、强征劳役的罪证，他们不仅盘剥低阶修士的宗门福利，更逼迫散修与凡人日夜劳作，就为换取更多毒膏！
飞红峰主柳青锋一步踏出，手中竹简展开，密密麻麻的朱砂小字在简上浮动。
他指尖在简面一划，那些字符顿时凌空飞起，在殿中排列成清晰的数据：
服用毒膏的修士中——他每说一句，就有一行朱字亮起，三年内修为停滞者，十占其七；左侧浮现数十名修士盘坐修炼却灵力凝滞的景象，修为倒退者，十有其二；右侧显现几名修士吐血散功的画面。
朱笔突然从他袖中激射而出，在空中龙飞凤舞写下道基损毁四个血字。
那字迹不断渗出猩红液体，滴落在地竟腐蚀出缕缕青烟。
content_en:
In the Heavenly Cauldron Peak Cangqiong Imperial Mansion, the swaying flames of ninety-nine ancient bronze lamps illuminated the palace as if it were daytime.
The leader of the Divine Eagle Clan, Ying Wuya, sat on the jade throne of the sect leader. The outstretched eagle embroidered with gold thread on his black robe glowed coldly under the light.
The great monk on the ninth floor of the Purity Realm tapped the handrail rhythmically with his right index finger. The handrail made of black ice iron made a crisp sound, which was particularly harsh in the silent hall.
Today’s discussion is about Lingtai Mingjing Ointment.
Ying Wuya's voice was like the sound of gold and iron, carrying unquestionable majesty. Lord Mo Xue, since you insist on discussing this matter, let's talk about it first.
Jiang Xuehan, the master of Mo Xuefeng, took three steps forward. The sword on his waist was automatically unsheathed three inches, and the sword trembled and made a clear sound like a dragon's roar.
His beard and hair were spread out, and he said angrily: The sect leader uses Lingtai Mingjing Ointment to call the outside sect poisonous. I cannot agree with you!
The sleeves and robes move automatically without wind, which shows that they are extremely angry. The evil cultivators of the Yinwu Sect and other heretics have branded this viciousness as the Lingtai Mirror. They are clearly trying to lure the mortal monks of our sect to flock to it in order to make huge profits from it!
He waved his hand suddenly, and two groups of light and shadow appeared out of thin air in the hall.
The left side shows the miserable state of a mortal who has become emaciated after taking ingestion, while the right side shows the image of a monk whose spiritual power is blocked in his meridians.
This poison is divided into two categories: one is called Xiaoyao Powder, which is designed to harm mortals.
The person who smokes it will feel like a fairy at first, but over time, his body and mind will be damaged, and he will eventually become a walking corpse; the second one is called a heart-corroding poison, which is designed to destroy the monk's foundation.
Jiang Xuehan pointed his sword at the light and shadow on the right side, and his voice became more and more fierce. The evil cultivator lied that this poison can help to enlighten the way of heaven, but in fact it is just a refined phantom poison that makes people fall into a false state!
What's even more vicious is that when he turns the edge of his sword, black threads wrapped around his meridians appear in the light and shadow. This poison contains black soul grass refined by special techniques. Once contaminated, it will be like gangrene attached to the bone and will be difficult to remove for life!
The lights of the ancient lamps in the hall suddenly dimmed, as if they were frightened by the anger in these words.
Jiang Xuehan fluttered his robe sleeves, and a clear water mirror flew out from his sleeves and hung in the center of the hall.
Ripples appeared on the mirror surface, gradually revealing a shocking picture——
Everyone, let’s take a look at the flow of our sect’s spiritual stones in the past three years.
The scene in the mirror turned into a rushing river of spiritual stones, and nearly 40% of the bright spiritual light flowed to the northwest where the Hidden Mist Sect was located.
Last year alone, 7.8 million spiritual stones were leaked due to the purchase of this poison!
Jiang Xuehan pointed his sword at the mirror, and a ray of silver light flashed across, marking the spiritual stones flowing to the Hidden Mist Sect individually.
Those spiritual stones piled up into mountains, casting huge shadows in the mirror.
Master Tianxuan Peak suddenly stood up, the pearl on the jade crown shaking violently: This is equivalent to the annual output of our sect's three medium-sized spiritual mines!
The trouble goes far beyond that.
Jiang Xuehan turned the edge of his sword, and the water mirror image flowed, showing the scene of thirty cities in the southeast.
Several monks wearing Taishi Dao Sect costumes were seen receiving the black jade box from the Yinwu Sect envoy in the mansion.
The stone tablet mark embroidered on the sleeves of the messenger was clearly visible in the mirror.
Even more terrifying is the damage caused by corrosion.
Jiang Xuehan's voice was sad. Two hundred and thirty-seven monks stationed there have been investigated for accepting bribes.
The picture in the mirror changed again, showing evidence of the crimes of these monks who withheld their monthly salary and forced labor. They not only exploited the benefits of the sect of low-level monks, but also forced casual monks and mortals to work day and night in exchange for more poisonous ointment!
Liu Qingfeng, the master of Feihong Peak, stepped forward and unfolded the bamboo slips in his hands, with dense cinnabar characters floating on the slips.
With his fingertips swiping across the scroll, the characters immediately flew into the air and were arranged into clear data in the hall:
Among the monks who took the poison ointment - every time he said a word, a line of red characters lit up. Seven out of ten monks had stagnated cultivation within three years. On the left side, there was a scene of dozens of monks sitting cross-legged practicing but with stagnant spiritual power. Two out of ten monks had regressed in cultivation. On the right side, there was a scene of several monks vomiting blood and dispersing their kung fu.
The ink pen suddenly shot out from his sleeve, and wrote the four bloody words "Daoji destroyed" in the air..
The writing continued to ooze scarlet liquid, and when it dripped to the ground, it corroded into wisps of green smoke.
